note: The frozen catalogue of historical episodes the alert system MUST detect.
It is a GATE INPUT for Stage 2 (mandate 28 and 29), not a Stage 1 gate: the
recall number it produces is only meaningful once an operator has fixed the
It ships EMPTY on purpose. Every entry names a real market episode and a
real window, and inventing either would manufacture a recall number that
nothing measured — the same failure mode as inventing a [PIN] threshold.
Until an operator freezes entries here, `mandatory_event_total` is 0 and the
replay report says recall is not yet measurable rather than reporting 100%.
Set `frozen` to true in the same commit that adds the first entries; after
that the file is append-only, because silently deleting an event the system
failed to detect would turn a miss into a pass.

entry_shape.window_start: ISO-8601 UTC — earliest input that could reasonably detect it
entry_shape.window_end: ISO-8601 UTC — latest input that still counts as timely
entry_shape.max_detection_slots: integer — recompute slots allowed before it counts as late
entry_shape.source: where the operator took the dates from
